IN pursuance of provisions of clause (3) of Article 348 of the Constitution, the Governor is
pleased to order the publication of the following English translation of notification no. 1373/IX-6–2020-
7C.V.-2020, dated December 14, 2020 :
No. 1373/IX-6–2020-7C.V.-2020
Dated Lucknow, December 14, 2020
THE following draft notification, which the Governor proposes to issue in exercise of the powers
under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution of India, read with sub section (2) of section 3 of the
Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P.Act no.2 of 1916) for including the areas specified in
Schedule-I below in the smaller urban area of Municipal Council Mungra Badshahpur, district Jaunpur is
hereby published for information of all concerned and with a view to inviting objections and suggestions in
respect thereof as required by sub-section (1) of section 4 of the said Act.
2- Objections and suggestions, if any, with respect to the proposed notification should be sent in
writing addressed to the Pramukh Sachiv, Nagar Vikas Anubhag-6, Uttar Pradesh Shasan, Bapu Bhavan,
Lucknow. Only those objections and suggestions which are received within fifteen days from the date of
publication of this notification in the Gazette shall be taken into consideration.
DRAFT NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution read with sub-
section (2) of section 3 of the Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act,1916 (U.P.Act no.2 of 1916), the Governor
is pleased to include the area specified in Schedule-1 below in the smaller urban area of Municipal Council
Mungra Badshahpur, District Jaunpur for the purposes of Part IX-A of the Constitution and is further
pleased to notify under clause (d) of Article 243-P of the Constitution that the areas specified in Schedule-2
shall be the territorial area of the said Municipal Council after including the areas specified in Schedule-1 .
